scope: ISSUE-017 AI history, queue organization, compact known references

runs.causeAndDisposition: 33 setup errors: missing parent of pytest basetemp; 1 old assertion expected expanded legacy data, intentionally replaced by compact references.
Collection error: standalone fixture used the wrong import root.
2 fixture failures: mutable alias changed the old artifact. A fresh room snapshot and a separate candidate data copy corrected the fixture.

5 product failures: active generation candidates were archivable (3 states), cancelled requests remained in active queue (2 kinds). One fixture failure used a nonexistent repository.directory attribute.
Product gap: direct player creation button omitted submissionKey after a lost response; retry could create another request. Added stable per-content key and browser regression.

Product regression introduced by dispatch serialization: public player submit already had a repository transaction. Fixed by joining the existing transaction under the same lock, preserving the archive/dispatch barrier.

limits: Deterministic provider fixtures and real local hosts/browsers; this is not a paid model success rate.
Package integration and engine schema runs are recorded separately and not added to the unique AI count.
Historical permission revocation, deleted objects and unprovable legacy searches remain hidden. No formal room was migrated or modified.
